name: overlay
title: Overlay
description: Where a tooltip or a toast is drawn on device: a layer over the app (OverlayHost, which ToastProvider draws) and one inside each Modal (OverlayLayer, which the dialog, popover, menu and select draw), so a ScrollView does not clip it and an open dialog does not cover it. Nothing on the web draws one: radix portals to <body> there.
